name: Nereid Origin — Marianne and Cassandra
tagline: The woman who wrote it, the woman it was written for, and the twelve daughters between them.
body:
DR. MARIANNE HATHAWAY created Project Nereid. She is the Dr. Hathaway already named across the Archive — the one who made Leviathan's Subject 00-400 consent-based, and the one Abbi transitioned with after St. Jonah. One woman, one surname, and the Archive had her filed as a footnote to her own invention.

She built it for CASSANDRA, who became THE FIRST AFFIRMED WOMAN. They are married. Every girl in every Haven is downstream of a system one woman wrote for the woman she loved, which is either the least surprising origin this canon could have had or the most.

MARIANNE IS CIS — and NOT BY CHOICE. Eden's genetic lock puts the prostate key in the Immutable Core, so Nereid cannot take on her. She built a door she could never walk through, and kept adding rooms behind it. AND HER GREATEST WEAKNESS IS HER WIFE LIVING IN THAT BODY — Cassandra, five foot eleven, thirteen inches, E-cups. She wrote the whole system with a sample size of one, in love with it, unable to test a single result on herself. That is the root of v7's flaw: the failure was never care, it was that she could reason about an outcome and never once feel where two of her own systems collided. Which puts her on the receiving end of the rule the system already carries: a hundred per cent pregnancy rate for an affirmed girl on a cis girl, gestation accelerating with every creampie. Cassandra gave her TWELVE DAUGHTERS, THREE AT A TIME. Four pregnancies. NINE BORN-AFFIRMED and THREE BORN CIS.

CASSANDRA IN THE ROOM SHE MADE POSSIBLE. Junoesque, cottagecore, a cream dress scattered with tiny strawberries over the fullness of her chest and hips and the soft weight of her stomach — WITH POCKETS, because pocketless clothing is a patriarchal misdemeanour. Pruning shears in one, stolen caramels in the other. She does not announce herself as proof of what Nereid can do; her body is allowed to be ORDINARY in the clinic it built.

AND THE COUNT IS NOT CLOSED. An empty frame stands beside the picnic photograph. Marianne has written across the insert: DAUGHTERS THIRTEEN THROUGH FIFTEEN ARE NOT AN ADMINISTRATIVE CERTAINTY. Cassandra has added YET beneath it in green ink.

Born-affirmed is its own category and worth holding apart from Nereid-affirmed: those nine did not need the system. They arrived as what it makes. The woman who wrote the cure had daughters who never required it, and three who are built like her instead.
rules: Dr. Marianne Hathaway — creator of Project Nereid. CIS, never affirmed
Cassandra — THE FIRST AFFIRMED WOMAN. The system was built for her
Twelve daughters, borne by Marianne, three at a time — four pregnancies
Nine BORN-AFFIRMED — born as what Nereid makes, never needing it
The 100% pregnancy rate and accelerated gestation are why the count is twelve and the timeline is short
